string-array.name: motivation_focus
string-array.item: Your attention is yours. Every pause gives a little room back to what matters.
Take a breath before you open that app. What you\'re doing deserves one more minute.
A short focus block counts. Start with one and notice how it feels.
You don\'t have to be perfect. Coming back to your task is already progress.
Your mind works better with space. Give it five minutes without a screen.

string-array.name: motivation_sleep
string-array.item: Resting is moving forward too. Tonight, put your phone down a little earlier.
One second of air before bed changes how you wake up.
Your body is grateful for dark screens. Try ten minutes less today.
You don\'t have to solve everything before sleep. Tomorrow will bring more light.
Every night counts. Today, one small step toward rest is enough.

string-array.name: motivation_presence
string-array.item: There\'s something in front of you worth looking at. Lift your eyes for a moment.
Being here is a choice too. Breathe and stay a little longer.
The best conversations happen with no screens in between.
One present moment is worth a hundred scrolls. Pick one today.
Look around and notice three things. That\'s the air you were looking for.

string-array.name: motivation_mental_health
string-array.item: Taking care of yourself includes taking breaks. This is one.
It\'s okay to go slowly. Breathe and ask what you need right now.
You don\'t have to keep up with everything. Your calm matters too.
A short break from screens can ease more than it seems.
Today isn\'t about performing, it\'s about feeling well. One breath at a time.

string-array.name: motivation_free_time
string-array.item: Your free time is yours. What would you like to do with these minutes?
Every minute you get back is a door to something you enjoy.
That hobby you put on hold is waiting. Give it ten minutes today.
Time comes back minute by minute, not all at once. You\'re doing well.
Pick something you love and give it to yourself. The rest can wait.

string-array.name: motivation_general
string-array.item: One second of air is enough to choose what you want to do next.
Breathe. You decide where your attention goes today.
You don\'t need to do it perfectly. Every pause adds up.
Your day is yours. Start with the next minute.
Noticing is the first step. You\'re already doing it.
